findings.claim: The global CleanUpService ticker in cleanup.go was changed from 10 minutes to 1 minute. As a result, all cleanup jobs (snapshots, query history, short URLs, temp users, annotations, etc.) run 10x as often, and the loop can run nearly continuously when a run takes longer than a minute.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77, the ticker is set to `time.Minute * 1` and each tick synchronously runs `srv.clean(ctx)` (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:78-85), which executes all eight cleanup jobs (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:96-105) under a 9-minute timeout (pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:89). Because `time.Ticker` buffers one pending tick while `srv.clean(ctx)` runs, any cleanup pass taking longer than a minute causes the next pass to start immediately after it finishes.

findings.claim: The cleanup log statements include the full ids slice, which can contain thousands of annotation IDs and produce very large log lines.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534, 554, and 576, CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags pass the entire ids slice ("ids", ids) to r.log.Error on every cleanup batch. Because ids is bounded only by the uncapped AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize setting (pkg/setting/setting.go:710, tested up to 32767 in pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/cleanup_test.go:101), this can log thousands of IDs per line.

findings.claim: The cleanup log statements log 'err' after the error has already been checked and returned, so the logged value is always nil.

verifier.reason: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go:534, 554, and 576, the three r.log.Error calls in CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags log err immediately after an `if err != nil { return 0, err }` check (lines 531-533, 551-553, and 573-575). Because non-nil errors return early, the logged err value is always nil.
